correctness.rationale: Exact Parikh reduction for any half length h=tn+r; two consecutive circular r-arcs have symmetric difference size 2min(r,n-r); uniqueness of all non-a letters forces r=1 or n-1 and the a-pair to be adjacent. A distinct one-step conjugate witness with half length n-1 exists exactly in the adjacent case and proves optimal girth. Necklace counts follow from primitivity and cyclic block fusion. Direct independent brute-force checker tests all cyclic classes q=2..7 without using the proof criterion to detect mesosomes.

value.rationale: Identifies a motivated minimal noninjective periodic word family (one repeated symbol), proves a complete dichotomy between infinite avoidance and a sharp length-2q first forbidden factor, and gives exact factorial enumeration of both circular families for all q. Demonstrates nontrivial square-containing periodic mesosome-free words for q>=3, a structural boundary not furnished by the cited binary results; no general theorem for arbitrary content is claimed.
